The '''Sublight missile corvette''' was a [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] model developed by [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]-dominated worlds of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] known as the Axis to defend against [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] raids.

==History==
Despite their successful defense of the Perlemian during the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict]], the sublight corvettes were not the decisive factor in ending the war.
